id.description: Unique id; relations name it in from / to, and feedback targets it.

kind.description: What it is; sets its shape, colour and default icon (person/role: violet; database/queue/storage: aqua cylinder or pill; action: orange; function/action: notched card; the rest: blue card).

tech.description: The technology (FastAPI, Postgres, Kafka) — shown in the tag line [Container · FastAPI].

description.description: What it does, one sentence; up to three lines show on the box.

external.description: Outside the scope being described: drawn grey and dashed.

boundary.description: The id of the boundary it sits in.

icon.description: An icon tag (<pack>.<icon>); overrides the kind's default icon. Must resolve — `flow icons check`.

ref.description: The name of the chart that zooms into this element; drawn as Open ↗.

status.description: For a migration chart: migrating (orange badge) or target (dashed badge); current shows nothing.

note.description: Shown on hover; cite file:line where facts come from code.

links.description: What it is made of or documented by: code (path:line), docs, assets, URLs — chips that open them.

inputs.description: Code level: what it takes, each typed by a data schema kind.

returns.description: Code level: the data schema kind it returns; a chip that opens that schema.
